item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): Sondierungen fortgesetzt | Wirtschaft in Brandenburg | Landeslabor in Adlershof
item.description:
Originally published Thu 15 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Linke, Grüne und SPD haben in Berlin die Gespräche wieder aufgenommen. Dabei sind gleich mitten in eine Kundgebung geraten: Begrüßt wurden sie am Haus der Statistik von Streikenden der Charité. Außerdem: Brandenburger Landtag zur Wirtschaft. Klage gegen Gebetsverbot an Schule. Landeslabor Berlin-Brandenburg öffnet Türen.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 07:42): Four killed in school shooting in US state of Oregon
item.description:
Originally published Fri 16 Oct 2026 07:42 IDT.

A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, in the US state of Oregon. The gunman was shot dead by a member of the public. Also: Britain's defence secretary says he's been reassured by the US that Starlink satellite services used by Ukraine’s military have been restored. In Yemen, the presidential palace and seat of the government in the port city of Aden has been attacked by Houthi rebels. Venezuela's ousted President Nicolas Maduro pleads not guilty to conspiracy to torture in a New York court. The Fifa president, Gianni Infantino, apologizes to the organisation's council for his plan to sell stakes in the World Cup. We hear from people with sight loss that say smart glasses are a 'game changer'; and a 99-year-old becomes the world's oldest wing walker.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
